content.short: Superfarm is an open, accessible NFT platform that requires no coding knowledge to participate.
content.description: Superfarm, founded in 2021 by Eliot Wainman, enables creators, developers, and communities to design, deploy, develop, and farm non-fungible tokens. The project aims to democratize the NFT space by removing technical and financial barriers, making it more accessible to the average user. With Superfarm, anyone can launch their own NFT farms and issue NFTs on the platform without writing code, opening participation across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon, and Solana and across a variety of use cases.
content.meta: Superfarm enables the creation, deployment, development, and farming of non-fungible tokens. Discover Superfarm and other NFT Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
